name: Are off-market properties more expensive or less expensive than on-market ones?

mainEntity.name: Are off-market properties more expensive or less expensive than on-market ones?

acceptedAnswer.text: The price of off-market properties can vary widely; they are not inherently cheaper or more expensive than on-market ones. Sometimes sellers prioritize a quick, discreet sale over top dollar, leading to potential discounts. Other times, a unique property might command a premium due to its exclusivity. A key decision factor is the seller's motivation; understanding why a seller is opting for an off-market sale (e.g., privacy, urgency, avoiding public exposure) can significantly influence the asking price and your negotiation strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Off-market property prices vary; they can be cheaper due to seller urgency or more expensive due to exclusivity. Seller motivation is a key factor.
